description: Direction (016 T014o, round-6 review F1, v05). A line that is itself a pre start closes its element on the same line, so the tracker returns to inline text, not to a block ending at a blank line. The wrapped code span after it holds a quoted opener with no closer before the blank line, so the visible rule's marker after it is a standalone comment and must be harvested. The digest on disk carries the visible rule, so the check must say OK. Without the exclusion of a raw-text start from the tag-line resume, the span's opener is not disarmed and the visible marker is lost.
